the-office-s01.title: Pilot
the-office-s01.summary: A documentary crew arrives at the offices of Dunder Mifflin to observe the employees and learn about modern management.

the-office-s01.title: Diversity Day
the-office-s01.summary: A consultant arrives to teach the staff about tolerance and diversity but Michael insists on imparting his own knowledge. Meanwhile, Jim struggles to keep hold of a lucrative contract extension.

the-office-s01.title: Health Care
the-office-s01.summary: Michael doesn't want to upset the staff so he gets Dwight to pass on news about the company's reduced health provisions.

the-office-s01.title: The Alliance
the-office-s01.summary: Michael arranges a morale-boosting birthday party for Meredith and is determined to come up with the funniest message in her card.

the-office-s01.title: Basketball
the-office-s01.summary: The office staff play a basketball game against the warehouse workers in which Jim shows off to impress Pam and upstage her fiancee who is on the opposing team.

the-office-s01.title: Hot Girl
the-office-s01.summary: A woman who comes to the office to sell purses gets the male members of staff excited. She rejects Dwight's advances, but Michael reckons he's still in with a chance.

the-office-s02.title: The Dundies
the-office-s02.summary: It's time for the "Dundies", Dunder Mifflin's annual awards banquet (held at the neighborhood Chili's), and the staff must endure the excruciating performance of their inept emcee, boss Michael Scott.

the-office-s02.title: Sexual Harassment
the-office-s02.summary: Just as corporate tells Toby, one of the workers at the Scranton branch, to give a seminar on sexual harassment issues, Michael receives a visit from his obnoxious sales-rep friend Todd Packer.

the-office-s02.title: Office Olympics
the-office-s02.summary: While Michael and Dwight are out of the office for the day trying to close a deal on a new condo for Michael, Jim and Pam arrange for the staff to participate in an "Office Olympics," where the workers play...

the-office-s02.title: The Fire
the-office-s02.summary: The Office is forced into the parking lot for the day when a fire starts in the kitchen.

the-office-s02.title: Halloween
the-office-s02.summary: While everyone else in the office enjoys the spooky Halloween festivities and talks about the staff's costumes, Michael ponders who he should fire when the threat of downsizing becomes a reality and his boss...

the-office-s02.title: The Fight
the-office-s02.summary: When Dwight embarrasses Michael by punching him in the stomach at work, Jim organizes a lunchtime rematch at Dwight's Dojo.

the-office-s02.title: The Client
the-office-s02.summary: When Michael and Jan try to nail down a potential new client, Christian, by taking him out to Chili's, Michael surprises everyone with what - or who - he does.

the-office-s02.title: Performance Review
the-office-s02.summary: Michael meets with all of his underlings to discuss their performance in the office so far.

the-office-s02.title: E-Mail Surveillance
the-office-s02.summary: Michael starts monitoring the emails sent out in the Dunder-Mifflin workplace, upsetting the employees.

the-office-s02.title: Christmas Party
the-office-s02.summary: Michael hosts a Christmas party at the office, but somehow manages to decrease the holiday cheer when he changes the arranged secret Santa pairs to a game of "Yankee Swap", where everyone gives their...

the-office-s02.title: Booze Cruise
the-office-s02.summary: Michael takes the entire Dunder-Mifflin staff on a motivational cruise aboard a party boat on Lake Wallenpaupack, but his planned presentation is bogged down by numerous distractions, including a dance...

the-office-s02.title: The Injury
the-office-s02.summary: When Michael burns his foot with his George Foreman mini-grill, he requires the entire office staff to work around his new injury.

the-office-s02.title: The Secret
the-office-s02.summary: When Michael slips some sly references about Pam in his conversations with Jim, Jim quickly tries to do damage control to make sure that no one else in the office finds about his crush on Pam, all while...

the-office-s02.title: The Carpet
the-office-s02.summary: When someone soils the carpet in Michael's office, Michael sees it as a form of hatred towards him and realizes for the first time that not everyone may like him.

the-office-s02.title: Boys and Girls
the-office-s02.summary: Jan holds a "Women in the Workplace" seminar at Dunder-Mifflin for the paper company's female employees.

the-office-s02.title: Valentine's Day
the-office-s02.summary: The Dunder-Mifflin staffers join in kindergarten-like festivities for Valentine's Day while Michael heads to New York City for a conference with the corporate heads.

the-office-s02.title: Dwight's Speech
the-office-s02.summary: Dwight must confront his fear of public speaking when he is named Dunder-Mifflin's Salesman of the Year.

the-office-s02.title: Take Your Daughter to Work Day
the-office-s02.summary: A routine office day is changed when children come to Dunder Mifflin for "Take Your Daughter to Work Day".

the-office-s02.title: Michael's Birthday
the-office-s02.summary: As Kevin and the rest of the crew worry about Kevin's medical test results to see whether or not he has skin cancer, Michael gets angry because no one seems to have fun at the birthday party he threw for...

the-office-s02.title: Drug Testing
the-office-s02.summary: Dwight plays the role of Volunteer Sheriff after finding half a joint in the Dunder Mifflin parking lot leading to an investigation.

the-office-s02.title: Conflict Resolution
the-office-s02.summary: When Michael takes over conflict resolution duties from HR, chaos ensues at Dunder Mifflin.

the-office-s02.title: Casino Night
the-office-s02.summary: In the season finale, Dunder-Mifflin holds a Casino Night in the warehouse to benefit charity.

the-office-s03.title: Gay Witch Hunt
the-office-s03.summary: After Michael found out Oscar was gay, he wanted to know who else in the office was homosexual.

the-office-s03.title: The Convention
the-office-s03.summary: Kelly set Pam up on her first date since breaking up with Roy. She was very nervous. Michael tried giving her dating tips and told her she should freak her date out by wearing her wedding dress.

the-office-s03.title: The Coup
the-office-s03.summary: Michael had made it a point to have Movie Monday every week. He called the office into the conference room to watch a 30-minute installment of Varsity Blues, but Jan made an unexpected visit and did not like...

the-office-s03.title: Grief Counseling
the-office-s03.summary: Jim felt awkward at the morning meeting when his boss put him charge of managing Karen and her responsibilities. The other co-workers looked at Jim as a kiss ass.

the-office-s03.title: Initiation
the-office-s03.summary: Dwight was very excited because he got to take Ryan on his first sales call. He couldn't wait to show Ryan how the sales are really done.

the-office-s03.title: Diwali
the-office-s03.summary: Michael was educating the entire staff about Diwali, the Hindu holiday that Kelly celebrated. Kelly had invited everybody from work to the celebration.

the-office-s03.title: Branch Closing
the-office-s03.summary: Jan told Michael that the board had voted to close the Scranton branch. There would be a select group of employees that would get a severance package; the others would be going to work at the Stamford branch.

the-office-s03.title: The Merger
the-office-s03.summary: The Scranton branch was getting ready for their new employees to arrive in from the defunct Stamford branch. Pam was especially excited to be reunited with Jim.

the-office-s03.title: The Convict
the-office-s03.summary: Angela and Kevin were trying to figure out where extra money in the budget came from. Jan let them know it was money Dunder-Mifflin received for hiring an ex-convict.

the-office-s03.title: A Benihana Christmas
the-office-s03.summary: Michael was in the holiday spirit and couldn't wait to share in it with his girlfriend, Carol. He had bought two tickets to paradise, hoping to whisk her away on a romantic vacation to Jamaica.

the-office-s03.title: Back From Vacation
the-office-s03.summary: Karen and Jim had their first big fight in the relationship. Karen had been living in a hotel since taking her job in Scranton.

the-office-s03.title: Traveling Salesmen
the-office-s03.summary: Michael decided to send his employees out into the field for sales calls. He paired himself up with Andy. He let the veterans choose who they wanted their partners to be.

the-office-s03.title: Ben Franklin
the-office-s03.summary: Michael celebrates Phyllis' wedding shower by bringing two adult performers into the office, a stripper and Ben Franklin. Meanwhile, Karen confronts Pam about her past history with Jim.

the-office-s03.title: Phyllis' Wedding
the-office-s03.summary: It was the day of Phyllis and Bob's wedding. Pam was upset because she noticed Phyllis had basically stolen Pam's ideas for her and Roy's would-be wedding.

the-office-s03.title: Business School
the-office-s03.summary: Roy stopped by Pam's desk to let her know how excited he was to see her art show. She reminded him that it was just a small show being put on by her art class.

the-office-s03.title: Cocktails
the-office-s03.summary: Michael was excited to be attending a party at his CFO's house. He carpooled with Dwight and was also looking forward to meeting Jan at the party.

the-office-s03.title: The Negotiation
the-office-s03.summary: Roy paced in the parking lot outside Dunder-Mifflin and then charged the building looking for Jim.

the-office-s03.title: Safety Training
the-office-s03.summary: Andy was back to work, fresh from anger management training. He insisted on being called Drew, even though Jim continued to call him Andy just to toy with him.

the-office-s03.title: Product Recall
the-office-s03.summary: Michael was in crisis mode at Dunder-Mifflin when a disgruntled employee at the paper mill put an obscene watermark on one of their most popular orders of paper.

the-office-s03.title: Women's Appreciation
the-office-s03.summary: Phyllis walked into the office looking pale and shocked. A concerned staff surrounded her for comfort. She told them she had been flashed in the parking lot.

the-office-s03.title: Beach Games
the-office-s03.summary: Michael was shocked when he received a call from Corporate wanting him to interview for a position. Michael was happy, but he also had other things on his mind.

the-office-s03.title: The Job
the-office-s03.summary: After Pam's outburst at Beach Day, she and Jim had a talk and realized how much they both missed their friendship.

the-office-s04.title: Fun Run (1)
the-office-s04.summary: Michael comes to believe the office might be cursed in the wake of a freak accident. After scrutinizing each of his staffers' religious beliefs, he organizes a charity 5K "fun run."

the-office-s04.title: Dunder Mifflin Infinity (1)
the-office-s04.summary: Ryan returns to Scranton with a plan to bring Dunder Mifflin into the digital age by launching a new website - Dunder Mifflin Infinity.

the-office-s04.title: Launch Party (1)
the-office-s04.summary: Michael gleefully anticipates attending the company's Web-site launch party in New York.

the-office-s04.title: Money (1)
the-office-s04.summary: Michael is quickly going into debt with Jan renovating his condo. Meanwhile, it's a barn burner when Jim and Pam check in to the Schrute family farm, which has been converted into a bed-and-breakfast.

the-office-s04.title: Local Ad
the-office-s04.summary: Michael was excited to know Dunder Mifflin bought television ad space in local markets, including Scranton. Michael wanted to create the perfect commercial.

the-office-s04.title: Branch Wars
the-office-s04.summary: Karen was now the regional manager of the Utica branch and used her position of power to woo Stanley to her branch. For the right price, Stanley agreed to make the transfer.

the-office-s04.title: Survivor Man
the-office-s04.summary: Michael is feeling left out after finding out Ryan took a handful of branch managers and even Toby on a wilderness retreat, but didn't invite him.

the-office-s04.title: Deposition
the-office-s04.summary: Michael is driving to New York with Jan where he is going to speak at her deposition. Jan is suing Dunder Mifflin for four million dollars over her wrongful termination.

the-office-s04.title: Dinner Party
the-office-s04.summary: Michael stages an elaborate plan to finally get Pam and Jim over to his and Jan's place for a dinner party. Jim gets trapped into it and agrees to go. Dwight overhears and wants his invitation, too.

the-office-s04.title: Chair Model
the-office-s04.summary: Pam is becoming more and more annoyed with Michael and his indecisiveness about ordering a desk chair.

the-office-s04.title: Night Out
the-office-s04.summary: Ryan returns to Scranton but not to a warm welcome. He is making everyone in the branch come in on a Saturday to re-enter data into the new website.

the-office-s04.title: Did I Stutter?
the-office-s04.summary: Pam is sporting a new look at work with her glasses. She admits she spent the night at a "friend's" house and forgot her contact solution.

the-office-s04.title: Job Fair
the-office-s04.summary: Jim is wearing his best golfing uniform because he is hitting the links with a potential client, Phil Maguire.

the-office-s04.title: Goodbye Toby (1)
the-office-s04.summary: Toby leaves Dunder Mifflin, and Michael plans a huge goodbye party... out of joy. Angela refuses to help with it, so Michael turns to Phyllis. Dwight and Meredith harass Holly, their new HR representative.

the-office-s05.title: Weight Loss
the-office-s05.summary: Michael tries to motivate the Scranton branch to lose weight as part of an interoffice competition.

the-office-s05.title: Business Ethics
the-office-s05.summary: Holly leads a business ethics seminar as a result of Ryan's scandal, and when Michael encourages everyone to share their own unethical work behaviors, things get out of hand.

the-office-s05.title: Baby Shower
the-office-s05.summary: Michael practices for the birth of Jan's baby by having Dwight go over possible birthing scenarios. Meanwhile, Michael tells Holly that he will pretend to dislike her for Jan's benefit.

the-office-s05.title: Crime Aid
the-office-s05.summary: Michael and Holly have sex for the first time, and Michael holds a fund-raiser for the office after it is burglarized.

the-office-s05.title: Employee Transfer
the-office-s05.summary: Pam is embarrassed when she is the only person at corporate wearing a costume on Halloween. Holly and Michael take the long trip to Nashua after they get some shocking news from corporate.

the-office-s05.title: Customer Survey
the-office-s05.summary: Dwight and Jim are shocked when they get the results of the annual customer survey report. Pam and Jim decide they want to spend every minute together using their bluetooth phones.

the-office-s05.title: Business Trip
the-office-s05.summary: Michael is thrilled when he learns that David Wallace is sending him to Canada for a business trip, and wants to bring both Andy and Oscar with him.

the-office-s05.title: Frame Toby
the-office-s05.summary: A mysterious person in the office has made a huge mess in the microwave and will not clean it up.

the-office-s05.title: The Surplus
the-office-s05.summary: Michael has to spend the office surplus by they end of the day, but he can't decide between a copier or new chairs.

the-office-s05.title: Moroccan Christmas
the-office-s05.summary: Phyllis' Moroccan-themed holiday party goes up in flames when Meredith's hair catches on fire and Michael is forced to deal with the accident.

the-office-s05.title: The Duel
the-office-s05.summary: The office is on eggshells because Andy still hasn't found out about fiancee Angela's affair with Dwight. When Michael spills the beans, Dwight and Andy take matters into their own hands.

the-office-s05.title: Prince Family Paper
the-office-s05.summary: Michael and Dwight go undercover to do a bit of industrial espionage on a paper company competitor. Meanwhile, the rest of the office holds a debate to settle the question: is Hilary Swank hot?

the-office-s05.title: Stress Relief
the-office-s05.summary: Dwight must makes amends with the office after his fire safety seminar goes awry; Michael tries to get his employees to relax; Andy becomes convinced that Pam and Jim are film gurus.

the-office-s05.title: Lecture Circuit (1)
the-office-s05.summary: Michael goes on a speaking tour of the other branches to explain Scranton's relative success, accompanied by his driver, Pam.

the-office-s05.title: Lecture Circuit (2)
the-office-s05.summary: Michael and Pam continue their tour of the branches with Michael taking a lesson from their visit to Utica. Dwight and Jim struggle to fulfill their new party planning duties with a grumpy staff.

the-office-s05.title: Blood Drive
the-office-s05.summary: A mystery woman at the office blood drive catches Michael's eye. Dwight and Kevin both find women at the "Lonely Hearts Party," while Jim and Pam are forced to leave because of PDAs—so they have lunch with...

the-office-s05.title: Golden Ticket
the-office-s05.summary: Michael's idea to use "Golden Tickets" for prizes for clients causes a problem in the office. Kevin seeks advice from Andy, Jim, and Pam about dating.

the-office-s05.title: New Boss
the-office-s05.summary: Michael has big plans for his 15th anniversary party at Dunder Mifflin, but is in for a shock when the new, no-nonsense Vice President has some ideas of his own.

the-office-s05.title: Two Weeks
the-office-s05.summary: Michael's relationship with the new vice president becomes increasingly tense, as Michael finds an excuse to goof off even more than usual.

the-office-s05.title: Dream Team
the-office-s05.summary: The situation between Jim and his new boss Charles gets worse when they are competing in a parking lot soccer game. Michael tries to start his new business, but has trouble leaving his house.

the-office-s05.title: Michael Scott Paper Company
the-office-s05.summary: Tension and disillusionment begin to emerge as Michael, Pam, and Ryan move the Michael Scott Paper Company into a cramped "workspace" at the business park.

the-office-s05.title: Heavy Competition
the-office-s05.summary: Dwight's loyalty to Michael is tested when he finds a new hero in Charles. Meanwhile, Andy tries to provide for all of Jim's emotional needs.

the-office-s05.title: Broke
the-office-s05.summary: Michael's new company struggles to make early morning deliveries while the office tries to get their expense reports in on time after Angela enforces Dunder Mifflin's policy.

the-office-s05.title: Casual Friday
the-office-s05.summary: Michael has to mediate a dispute within his new sales team. Meanwhile, trouble brews in the office when several employees take the term "casual" Fridays too loosely.

the-office-s05.title: Cafe Disco
the-office-s05.summary: Michael decides to open a cafe-disco in his old office. Pam and Jim are planning a secret trip.

the-office-s05.title: Company Picnic
the-office-s05.summary: At the company picnic, Michael and Holly are reunited for the first time since their split. The rest of the staff competes in games, such as the volleyball tournament.

the-office-s06.title: Gossip
the-office-s06.summary: A few interns who stayed at Dunder-Mifflin over the summer end their internship.

the-office-s06.title: The Meeting
the-office-s06.summary: Michael gets worried after a request from Jim, and Pam's busy with wedding planning. Darryl's worker's compensation claim makes Dwight suspicious.

the-office-s06.title: The Promotion
the-office-s06.summary: David Wallace comes bearing the news that not all the staffers will receive a raise this year. Jim pushes Dwight to the limit and causes him to form office alliances.

the-office-s06.title: Niagara (1)
the-office-s06.summary: The Dunder Mifflin staff head to Niagara Falls for Jim and Pam's wedding, with the understanding that her pregnancy is a forbidden discussion topic, but Jim's slip of the tongue prods Michael to attempt damage...

the-office-s06.title: Mafia
the-office-s06.summary: Michael becomes convinced that an insurance salesman visiting the office is a part of the mafia, and Dwight and Andy accompany Michael to a meeting with him.

the-office-s06.title: The Lover
the-office-s06.summary: Jim and Pam return from their honeymoon and discover that Michael is dating Pam's mother, which infuriates her.

the-office-s06.title: Koi Pond
the-office-s06.summary: Michael and Jim head off to a meeting and Michael comes back soaked after having fallen in a koi pond. Meanwhile, Pam and Andy, as the two worst salesmen in the branch, have to go cold calling for sales.

the-office-s06.title: Double Date
the-office-s06.summary: Jim and Pam finally go on a double date with Michael and Pam's mother Helene on Helene's birthday, which takes a dark turn when Michael discovers just how old Helene is turning, and breaks up with her.

the-office-s06.title: Murder
the-office-s06.summary: Rumors spread that Dunder Mifflin is in financial trouble, so Michael tries to distract the office by having everyone play a murder mystery game called Belles, Bourbon, and Bullets.

the-office-s06.title: Shareholder Meeting
the-office-s06.summary: Michael speaks out of line at the Dunder Mifflin shareholders meeting and creates a big problem for management, while Jim discovers that nobody in the office thinks he's the "real" boss.

the-office-s06.title: Scott's Tots
the-office-s06.summary: Michael and Erin meet "Scott's Tots", a group of local teenagers whose college tuition was promised in one of Michael's grand delusions ten years prior.

the-office-s06.title: Secret Santa
the-office-s06.summary: Michael gets upset when Jim promises Phyllis that she can be the office Santa, but the office Christmas party may be overshadowed by some bad news from David Wallace.

the-office-s06.title: The Banker
the-office-s06.summary: A banker representing a potential buyer comes to the Scranton branch to interview the H.R. department before the sale goes through.

the-office-s06.title: Sabre
the-office-s06.summary: Michael hates the changes that Dunder Mifflin's new owner is implementing, so he turns to David Wallace for advice.

the-office-s06.title: The Manager and the Salesman
the-office-s06.summary: Sabre's CEO wants the Scranton branch to have one manager, and Michael voluntarily steps down and lets Jim become the boss when he finds out that salespeople make more money.

the-office-s06.title: The Delivery (1)
the-office-s06.summary: Pam’s contractions begin but she and Jim are determined to wait it out as long as possible so they can have more time at the hospital.

the-office-s06.title: St. Patrick's Day
the-office-s06.summary: Michael thinks he impressed Jo only to discover someone else in the office caught her eye. Meanwhile, Dwight makes trouble on Jim's first day back from paternity leave.

the-office-s06.title: New Leads
the-office-s06.summary: When the sales staff lets Sabre's new "sales is king" policy get to their heads, Michael hides their new, prized leads.

the-office-s06.title: Happy Hour
the-office-s06.summary: Michael gets kicked out of the bar when he pulls out all the stops to impress a friend of Jim and Pam's. Meanwhile, Andy and Erin do their best to keep their relationship under wraps.

the-office-s06.title: Secretary's Day
the-office-s06.summary: Andy pulls out all the stops to give Erin a memorable Secretary's Day. Michael reluctantly takes Erin out to lunch and lets slip about Andy's relationship with Angela.

the-office-s06.title: Body Language
the-office-s06.summary: Pam and Jim work on their first sales pitch together to Donna, the manager of a local restaurant. But Michael keeps misreading the signals she's putting out.

the-office-s06.title: The Cover-Up
the-office-s06.summary: Michael suspects Donna is cheating on him and puts P.I. Dwight Schrute on the case. Meanwhile, Andy is frustrated when no one takes his customer's complaint seriously.

the-office-s06.title: The Chump
the-office-s06.summary: Michael is surprisingly cheerful after learning some bad news about Donna. The new parents, Pam and Jim, have trouble staying awake in the office.

the-office-s06.title: Whistleblower
the-office-s06.summary: The press finds out that Sabre’s printers catch on fire. Jo shows up to the office in hopes of finding out who the whistleblower is. Everyone suspects Andy, who adamantly denies he leaked the information.

the-office-s07.title: Nepotism
the-office-s07.summary: Michael refuses to fire the new office assistant after everyone complains about his bad attitude. Andy plays it cool after Erin shows interest in another man.

the-office-s07.title: Counseling
the-office-s07.summary: Corporate assigns Michael to counseling with Toby. Dwight vows revenge on the Steamtown Mall after a shop owner snubs him. Meanwhile, Pam conspires to change her job title.

the-office-s07.title: Andy's Play
the-office-s07.summary: Andy invites the entire office to his community theater production of Sweeney Todd in hopes that Erin will attend.

the-office-s07.title: Sex Ed
the-office-s07.summary: Michael, believing he has herpes, contacts all his ex-girlfriends, including Jan and Holly. Andy tries to play on Erin’s compassionate side by holding a sex education meeting for the office.

the-office-s07.title: The Sting
the-office-s07.summary: When a competing sales associate steals a Dunder Mifflin client, Michael, Jim and Dwight decide to set up a sting to find out his sales secrets.

the-office-s07.title: Costume Contest
the-office-s07.summary: When Darryl takes an idea to corporate over his head, Michael freaks out. Everyone in the office is in a competitive mood as the Halloween costume contest gets underway.

the-office-s07.title: Christening
the-office-s07.summary: Pam and Jim prepare for Cece's baptism. When Cece goes missing, Jim fears Angela has taken her.

the-office-s07.title: Viewing Party
the-office-s07.summary: An ostracized Michael does all he can to sabotage Gabe's party while Angela requests sex from Dwight.

the-office-s07.title: WUPHF.com
the-office-s07.summary: Michael tries to save Ryan's company by encouraging co-workers to invest. Meanwhile, Dwight has big plans for the office at Thanksgiving.

the-office-s07.title: China
the-office-s07.summary: After reading an article about China growing as a global power, Michael decides China must be stopped before they take over the US.

the-office-s07.title: Classy Christmas (1)
the-office-s07.summary: Michael could not be happier when Toby has to take a leave of absence and corporate sends Holly Flax to cover for him.

the-office-s07.title: Classy Christmas (2)
the-office-s07.summary: Michael could not be happier when Toby has to take a leave of absence and corporate sends Holly Flax to cover for him.

the-office-s07.title: Ultimatum
the-office-s07.summary: Michael prepares himself for the good or bad news about Holly and her boyfriend.

the-office-s09.summary: Dwight becomes regional manager after Andy quits his job, Jim dedicates more time to his Dunder Mifflin job to save his marriage, and Angela has problems with her new living arrangements after her breakup with...

the-office-s09.summary: Jim convinces Dwight that he needs to choose someone to act as an Assistant to the Assistant Regional Manager; the two subsequently hold tryouts for the position.

the-office-s09.title: Finale
the-office-s09.summary: One year later, Dunder Mifflin employees past and present reunite for a panel discussion about the documentary and to attend Dwight and Angela's wedding.

always-sunny-s14.title: Paddy's Has a Jumper
always-sunny-s14.summary: Trapped inside Paddy's with a suicide jumper on the roof, the Gang wonders if they should bother intervening with an algorithm of their own - Could he, would he, should we?

always-sunny-s14.title: A Woman's Right to Chop
always-sunny-s14.summary: When a trendy new hair salon opens up right next door to Paddy's, Dennis and Frank go on the offensive to stop women from cutting off their hair. Meanwhile, Mac is reunited with his childhood dog Poppins..

always-sunny-s14.title: Waiting for Big Mo
always-sunny-s14.summary: In this spoof of Waiting for Godot, Dennis and Charlie stand guard at their laser tag base waiting to ambush their enemy, Big Mo, but Dennis has doubts about why they play laser tag and whether or not the...

always-sunny-s15.title: 2020: A Year in Review
always-sunny-s15.summary: The Gang looks back on 2020 to justify their numerous PPE loans. In doing so, it is revealed that they contributed to the chaos of the past political year way more than anyone could have imagined.

always-sunny-s15.title: The Gang Makes Lethal Weapon 7
always-sunny-s15.summary: Upon discovering that their self-made Lethal Weapon sequels have been pulled from the local library, the Gang decides to address their political incorrectness by making another film — Lethal Weapon 7.

always-sunny-s15.title: The Gang Buys a Roller Rink
always-sunny-s15.summary: In the past, an innocent Dennis learns the horrifying details of Frank's business, a truly sweet Dee is excited to head off for Hollywood, while Charlie and Mac's jobs at the roller rink are in jeopardy.

always-sunny-s15.title: The Gang Replaces Dee With a Monkey
always-sunny-s15.summary: When the Gang suspects Dee is menopausal, they scramble to find a new employee for Paddy's Pub. Dee decides to put her acting career on hold in order to mentor young actors.

always-sunny-s15.title: The Gang Goes to Ireland
always-sunny-s15.summary: The gang's in Dublin where Dennis ends up helping Frank with some of his business's dirty work. Mac and Charlie learn about their Irish heritage.

always-sunny-s15.title: The Gang's Still in Ireland
always-sunny-s15.summary: Dennis and Dee explore their new accommodations in the countryside. Frank accompanies Charlie to find the truth about Charlie's Irish childhood pen pal.

always-sunny-s15.title: Dee Sinks in a Bog
always-sunny-s15.summary: Mac spends a day at the seminary to truly understand what it takes to become a priest. Dennis and Frank plan an elaborate trap to humiliate Charlie's pen pal. Dee prepares for a date with an Irish doctor.

always-sunny-s15.title: The Gang Carries a Corpse Up a Mountain
always-sunny-s15.summary: The Gang attempts to ascend a mountain in order for Charlie to fulfill an old and mysterious Irish burial tradition. One by one, the Gang backs out until Charlie is left to honor the dead body alone.

always-sunny-s16.title: The Gang Inflates
always-sunny-s16.summary: Dennis and Mac get into inflatable furniture to deal with the economy’s inflation, while Dee tries to find a place to crash after being evicted by her greedy landlord and Charlie wants to pitch Frank his...

always-sunny-s16.title: Frank Shoots Every Member of the Gang
always-sunny-s16.summary: After Frank shoots Dennis and Dee, they resolve to take Frank’s gun away.

always-sunny-s16.title: The Gang Gets Cursed
always-sunny-s16.summary: The Gang’s going to be on Bar Rescue but a series of bad omens leads them to believe they are all cursed.

always-sunny-s16.title: Frank vs. Russia
always-sunny-s16.summary: Charlie cheers on Frank at a local chess tournament against a Russian grandmaster. Dennis helps Mac and Dee find boyfriends after getting irritated by Mac’s current boyfriend, Johnny.

always-sunny-s16.title: Celebrity Booze: The Ultimate Cash Grab
always-sunny-s16.summary: When news spreads of Bryan Cranston and Aaron Paul’s visit to Philadelphia to promote their Dos Hermanos mezcal brand, the Guys decide to pitch them their own liquor.

always-sunny-s16.title: Risk E. Rat's Pizza and Amusement Center
always-sunny-s16.summary: The gang goes to Risk E. Rat's, finding it updated with safety and overcautiousness. Dee takes Frank on a scavenger hunt to find risqué jokes hidden throughout the establishment.

always-sunny-s16.title: The Gang Goes Bowling
always-sunny-s16.summary: The guys crash Dee's bowling league night and compete in a Battle of the Sexes at a bowling alley owned by the McPoyles.

always-sunny-s16.title: Dennis Takes a Mental Health Day
always-sunny-s16.summary: After a physical reveals Dennis has high blood pressure, he decides to take a day away from The Gang to de-stress at the beach.

gilmore-girls-s01.title: Pilot
gilmore-girls-s01.summary: When Rory is accepted to attend a prestigious prep school, Lorelai must swallow her pride and ask her wealthy parents for help paying the tuition.

gilmore-girls-s01.title: The Lorelais' First Day at Chilton
gilmore-girls-s01.summary: Rory's first day at Chilton doesn't go smoothly: First, Lorelai's attire offends Emily and the headmaster; then Rory meets some obnoxious classmates.

gilmore-girls-s01.title: Kill Me Now
gilmore-girls-s01.summary: When Rory and Richard bond during a day of golf at the club, Lorelai feels jealous of Rory's deepening connection with her grandparents.

gilmore-girls-s01.title: The Deer Hunters
gilmore-girls-s01.summary: After Rory receives a bad grade on her English paper, Lorelai helps her cram for a big Shakespeare exam – but catastrophe strikes on test day.

gilmore-girls-s01.title: Cinnamon's Wake
gilmore-girls-s01.summary: Lorelai admits she has feelings for someone. Meanwhile, Rory has a budding relationship of her own that is moving forward.

gilmore-girls-s01.title: Rory's Birthday Parties
gilmore-girls-s01.summary: Rory clashes with Emily when Emily plans a formal birthday party for her. Meanwhile, Lorelai organizes a casual get-together to celebrate.

gilmore-girls-s01.title: Kiss and Tell
gilmore-girls-s01.summary: Rory shares a romantic moment with Dean, but doesn't tell Lorelai. When Lorelai hears about it from Mrs. Kim, she invites Dean over for movie night.

gilmore-girls-s01.title: Love and War and Snow
gilmore-girls-s01.summary: Snow strands Rory at her grandparents' home, while Lorelai spends the day with her beau. Meanwhile, Lane misses Rory and comes to visit.

gilmore-girls-s01.title: Rory's Dance
gilmore-girls-s01.summary: Rory attends her first dance with Dean but they get home late, causing Emily and Lorelai to fight over Lorelai's mothering skills.

gilmore-girls-s01.title: Forgiveness and Stuff
gilmore-girls-s01.summary: Misfortune strikes at the Gilmores' Christmas party. Dean assures Lorelai that nothing improper happened the night he and Rory fell asleep together.

gilmore-girls-s01.title: Paris is Burning
gilmore-girls-s01.summary: After Paris causes a scandal by exposing the relationship between a parent and a teacher, she is confronted.

gilmore-girls-s01.title: Double Date
gilmore-girls-s01.summary: Lorelai goes on a hellish double date with Sookie, Jackson and Jackson's odd cousin. Meanwhile, Rory double dates with Dean, Lane and Dean's friend.

gilmore-girls-s01.title: Concert Interruptus
gilmore-girls-s01.summary: Trouble ensues when Rory takes her friends to a Bangles concert in New York. Lorelai learns something about Luke's romantic past.

gilmore-girls-s01.title: That Damn Donna Reed
gilmore-girls-s01.summary: Rory and Dean argue about women's roles after watching "The Donna Reed Show." Emily makes Lorelai face her feelings.

gilmore-girls-s01.title: Christopher Returns
gilmore-girls-s01.summary: Rory's father returns, causing tension in Emily and Richard's house – and forcing Lorelai to make a big decision about her family's future.

gilmore-girls-s01.title: Star-Crossed Lovers and Other Strangers
gilmore-girls-s01.summary: Rory and Dean celebrate their three-month anniversary, but things don't go as planned. Luke's ex-girlfriend Rachel arrives in town.

gilmore-girls-s01.title: The Breakup, Part 2
gilmore-girls-s01.summary: After recent events, Rory keeps busy, refusing to give in to self-pity. Meanwhile, Stars Hollow's residents rally around her, much to her dismay.

gilmore-girls-s01.title: The Third Lorelai
gilmore-girls-s01.summary: When Lorelai's grandmother offers a trust fund for Rory's education, Emily fears losing contact with a financially independent Lorelai and Rory.

gilmore-girls-s01.title: Emily in Wonderland
gilmore-girls-s01.summary: Emily is horrified when she sees the place where Lorelai and Rory first lived, so she sets out to create a perfect bedroom for Rory in her house.

gilmore-girls-s01.title: P.S. I Lo...
gilmore-girls-s01.summary: Still upset over recent events, Rory becomes angry with Lorelai, who didn't tell her that she is dating again.

gilmore-girls-s01.title: Love, Daisies and Troubadours
gilmore-girls-s01.summary: Rory finally tells Dean the truth about how she feels about him. Sensing something between Lorelai and Luke, Rachel makes a decision.

gilmore-girls-s02.title: Sadie, Sadie...
gilmore-girls-s02.summary: Lorelai makes a big decision, but when Emily hears about it from someone else, she's hurt and angry that Lorelai didn't bother to tell her.

gilmore-girls-s02.title: Hammers and Veils
gilmore-girls-s02.summary: Rory's sudden flurry of extracurricular activity strains her relationship with Dean. Emily is cold when Lorelai finally reveals her big news.

gilmore-girls-s02.title: Red Light on the Wedding Night
gilmore-girls-s02.summary: During a wild party, Lorelai impulsively calls someone, and their conversation gives her second thoughts about her plans.

gilmore-girls-s02.title: The Road Trip to Harvard
gilmore-girls-s02.summary: With her big plans canceled, Lorelai is eager to escape the reactions of everyone in Stars Hollow, so she and Rory take off on a road trip.

gilmore-girls-s02.title: Nick & Nora/Sid & Nancy
gilmore-girls-s02.summary: Lorelai tries to dissuade Luke from allowing his relative to live with him. Rory finds herself attracted to another boy.

gilmore-girls-s02.title: Presenting Lorelai Gilmore
gilmore-girls-s02.summary: Rory surprises everyone by agreeing to make her debut at a ball, and Lorelai finds herself attracted to a changed man.

gilmore-girls-s02.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
gilmore-girls-s02.summary: Advised to become more social at Chilton, Rory winds up in the most popular school clique, while Lorelai helps with a fundraising fashion show.

gilmore-girls-s02.title: The Ins and Outs of Inns
gilmore-girls-s02.summary: Lorelai and Sookie have the first fight of their long friendship when Lorelai panics and decides their dream of opening an inn together will fail.

gilmore-girls-s02.title: Run Away, Little Boy
gilmore-girls-s02.summary: When Rory and her classmate Tristan are cast as Romeo and Juliet in a school play, a jealous Dean insists on attending every rehearsal.

gilmore-girls-s02.title: The Bracebridge Dinner
gilmore-girls-s02.summary: While Rory struggles to keep the budding rivalry between Dean and Jess under control, Lorelai invites most of Stars Hollow to an elaborate feast.

gilmore-girls-s02.title: Secrets and Loans
gilmore-girls-s02.summary: Lorelai can't afford to repair her home's extensive termite damage but becomes angry when Rory involves Emily, who again offers Lorelai a loan.

gilmore-girls-s02.title: Richard in Stars Hollow
gilmore-girls-s02.summary: Newly retired Richard is driving Emily crazy, so Lorelai agrees to take her father for a day in Stars Hollow, where he annoys both Lorelai and Rory.

gilmore-girls-s02.title: A-Tisket, A-Tasket
gilmore-girls-s02.summary: The annual Stars Hollow Picnic Basket Auction causes romantic complications when Jess outbids Dean to win a picnic lunch date with Rory.

gilmore-girls-s02.title: It Should've Been Lorelai
gilmore-girls-s02.summary: Christopher brings a visitor to Stars Hollow who wants to get to know Rory. Emily is furious that Lorelai isn't trying to win Christopher back.

gilmore-girls-s02.title: Lost & Found
gilmore-girls-s02.summary: Rory panics when she realizes she's lost the bracelet Dean made for her. When Lorelai spots someone in Rory's room, she makes accusations of theft.

gilmore-girls-s02.title: There's the Rub
gilmore-girls-s02.summary: Lorelai and Emily's weekend at a spa doesn't go as planned. Meanwhile, Rory's night alone becomes difficult when Paris, Jess and Dean arrive.

gilmore-girls-s02.title: Dead Uncles & Vegetables
gilmore-girls-s02.summary: Lorelai and Rory help out at the diner while Luke makes funeral arrangements. Emily goes overboard helping to plan a wedding.

gilmore-girls-s02.title: Back in the Saddle Again
gilmore-girls-s02.summary: After helping Rory with her project for Chilton's annual business fair, Richard realizes he's tired of retirement and wants to start a second career.

gilmore-girls-s02.title: Teach Me Tonight
gilmore-girls-s02.summary: As a favor to Luke, Rory tutors Jess, but during their first study session, Jess convinces Rory to go on a quick outing with him.

gilmore-girls-s02.title: Help Wanted
gilmore-girls-s02.summary: Lorelai helps Richard establish a consulting business. Rory becomes angry that everyone blames Jess for what happened to her.

gilmore-girls-s02.title: Lorelai's Graduation Day
gilmore-girls-s02.summary: Lorelai is about to graduate from business school, so Rory secretly invites guests to her graduation ceremony. Rory makes a trip to New York.

gilmore-girls-s02.title: I Can't Get Started
gilmore-girls-s02.summary: On the day before the wedding, Lorelai enjoys a romantic evening. Meanwhile, Rory is thrilled when a familiar face returns to Stars Hollow.

gilmore-girls-s03.title: Those Lazy-Hazy-Crazy Days
gilmore-girls-s03.summary: Back from a summer internship in Washington, D.C., Rory finds herself torn between Dean and Jess. Meanwhile, Lorelai questions her future.

gilmore-girls-s03.title: Haunted Leg
gilmore-girls-s03.summary: Emily's attempts to reunite Christopher with Lorelai and Rory result in an ugly confrontation between Rory and Christopher.

gilmore-girls-s03.title: Application Anxiety
gilmore-girls-s03.summary: After a Harvard application arrives, Rory and Lorelai seek advice. Meanwhile, Lane places an ad and becomes enamored with a respondent.

gilmore-girls-s03.title: One's Got Class and the Other One Dyes
gilmore-girls-s03.summary: Things get ugly when Lorelai speaks at the high school's career day. To rebel against her conservative mother, Lane does something drastic.

gilmore-girls-s03.title: Eight O'Clock at the Oasis
gilmore-girls-s03.summary: After a disastrous date with a man she met at an auction organized by Emily, Lorelai tries to cancel the second date, despite her parents' objections.

gilmore-girls-s03.title: Take the Deviled Eggs...
gilmore-girls-s03.summary: When Lorelai winds up attending a social event with Rory, she learns more about Christopher's life than she wanted to know.

gilmore-girls-s03.title: They Shoot Gilmores, Don't They?
gilmore-girls-s03.summary: Lorelai forces Rory to be her partner at the Stars Hollow dance marathon, where Rory can't stop arguing with a boy – and another definitely notices.

gilmore-girls-s03.title: Let the Games Begin
gilmore-girls-s03.summary: Lorelai, Rory, Richard and Emily visit Richard's alma mater, but Richard causes trouble by secretly making some arrangements in advance.

gilmore-girls-s03.title: A Deep-Fried Korean Thanksgiving
gilmore-girls-s03.summary: Lorelai and Rory have four Thanksgivings when they stop for celebrations with Lane, Sookie and Luke on the way to dinner with Richard and Emily.

gilmore-girls-s03.title: That'll Do, Pig
gilmore-girls-s03.summary: Lorelai misses the town carnival when a visitor arrives. Rory's beau won't take her to the carnival – until he learns she might go with another boy.

gilmore-girls-s03.title: I Solemnly Swear...
gilmore-girls-s03.summary: A classmate convinces Paris that Rory has been plotting against her. Meanwhile, Emily is sued by a former maid, and Lorelai meets an interesting man.

gilmore-girls-s03.title: Lorelai Out of Water
gilmore-girls-s03.summary: Lorelai gets an angling lesson from Luke before her fishing date with her new beau. Meanwhile, the political battle between Rory and Paris escalates.

gilmore-girls-s03.title: Dear Emily and Richard
gilmore-girls-s03.summary: When Sherry goes into labor and asks Rory to stay with her at the hospital, Lorelai reminisces about the day Rory was born.

gilmore-girls-s03.title: Swan Song
gilmore-girls-s03.summary: Lorelai goes away with her boyfriend for a weekend in New York, but she worries about leaving Rory and her boyfriend together.

gilmore-girls-s03.title: Face-Off
gilmore-girls-s03.summary: Tired of waiting for her boyfriend to call and make plans for the weekend, Rory goes to a hockey game with Lane, where she sees a familiar face.

gilmore-girls-s03.title: The Big One
gilmore-girls-s03.summary: Rory and Paris compete to give a speech at a school celebration. Meanwhile, Lorelai shares a passionate kiss with someone unexpected.

gilmore-girls-s03.title: A Tale of Poes and Fire
gilmore-girls-s03.summary: When a meeting of the Edgar Allan Poe Society at her inn is interrupted by a disaster, Lorelai must find rooms for the guests at homes around town.

gilmore-girls-s03.title: Happy Birthday, Baby
gilmore-girls-s03.summary: While Lorelai deals with the aftermath at the inn, Rory schemes to give her mom a special birthday party, complete with a gigantic surprise.

gilmore-girls-s03.title: Keg! Max!
gilmore-girls-s03.summary: Rory makes plans to attend the prom. Lane's rock band debuts at a big party, where longstanding animosities finally explode.

gilmore-girls-s03.title: Say Goodnight, Gracie
gilmore-girls-s03.summary: After the brawl at her band's debut, Lane is in trouble with her mother. Later, Jess receives a visitor at the diner.

gilmore-girls-s03.title: Here Comes the Son
gilmore-girls-s03.summary: Jess travels across the country for a visit. Rory helps Emily choose an outfit for Rory's graduation, resulting in a conflict with Lorelai.

gilmore-girls-s03.title: Those Are Strings, Pinocchio
gilmore-girls-s03.summary: Rory and Lorelai prepare for Rory's graduation from Chilton. But major developments involving the inn threaten to dampen the festivities.

gilmore-girls-s04.title: Ballrooms and Biscotti
gilmore-girls-s04.summary: After returning from a summer of backpacking through Europe, Rory and Lorelai frantically prepare for Rory's move to college.

gilmore-girls-s04.title: The Lorelais' First Day at Yale
gilmore-girls-s04.summary: Lorelai helps Rory move into her dorm, where she meets an odd new roommate, and learns that she will also be sharing her room with a familiar face.

gilmore-girls-s04.title: The Hobbit, the Sofa, and Digger Stiles
gilmore-girls-s04.summary: Emily redecorates Rory's dorm room without her permission. Lorelai and Sookie cater a kids' birthday party with a "Lord of the Rings" theme.

gilmore-girls-s04.title: Chicken or Beef?
gilmore-girls-s04.summary: While visiting Stars Hollow for the weekend, Rory encounters Dean, who awkwardly invites her to an event the next day.

gilmore-girls-s04.title: The Fundamental Things Apply
gilmore-girls-s04.summary: Lorelai struggles to hide details of her life from Emily. Rory discovers that college dating isn't easy. Lorelai invites Luke over for movie night.

gilmore-girls-s04.title: An Affair to Remember
gilmore-girls-s04.summary: Emily hires Lorelai and Sookie to cater an elaborate launch party for Richard's new company, but insists they prove that they are worthy of her trust.

gilmore-girls-s04.title: The Festival of Living Art
gilmore-girls-s04.summary: Rory and Lorelai participate in a Stars Hollow event in which the townspeople dress up and present tableaux imitating famous paintings.

gilmore-girls-s04.title: Die, Jerk
gilmore-girls-s04.summary: Rory tries to spice up her articles for the student newspaper. Luke admits to Lorelai that he is revisiting a past relationship.

gilmore-girls-s04.title: Ted Koppel's Big Night Out
gilmore-girls-s04.summary: Emily realizes that Richard has been secretly meeting someone for lunch for years. Lorelai accepts an invitation to dinner.

gilmore-girls-s04.title: The Nanny and the Professor
gilmore-girls-s04.summary: Lorelai and Sookie renovate their inn. Lorelai enjoys a romantic evening. Rory is irritated by Paris's new relationship.

gilmore-girls-s04.title: In the Clamor and the Clangor
gilmore-girls-s04.summary: Lorelai is upset that Luke has gotten an apartment in another town. Rory learns that a guy she likes has been spreading false information about her.

gilmore-girls-s04.title: A Family Matter
gilmore-girls-s04.summary: Luke is wary when his sister comes to town. Lorelai hesitates to tell her parents about her new beau. Paris's affair gets serious.

gilmore-girls-s04.title: Nag Hammadi Is Where They Found the Gnostic Gospels
gilmore-girls-s04.summary: Rory crosses paths with Jess in Stars Hollow. Luke's sister visits Stars Hollow and introduces her new boyfriend to her brother.

gilmore-girls-s04.title: The Incredible Sinking Lorelais
gilmore-girls-s04.summary: Overwhelmed by her classwork, Rory confides in Dean, who's working on the construction crew at the Dragonfly Inn.

gilmore-girls-s04.title: Scene in a Mall
gilmore-girls-s04.summary: Rory gets a glimpse of Dean's new life. When Lorelai and Rory spend a day at the mall, they run into Emily on a wild shopping spree.

gilmore-girls-s04.title: The Reigning Lorelai
gilmore-girls-s04.summary: Richard is devastated by a sudden loss. Emily receives a shock when she finds an old letter that was written to Richard.

gilmore-girls-s04.title: Girls in Bikinis, Boys Doin' the Twist
gilmore-girls-s04.summary: Rory and Paris head south for their first spring break in Florida, where they run into a couple of their old pals from Chilton.

gilmore-girls-s04.title: Tick, Tick, Tick, Boom!
gilmore-girls-s04.summary: Jason and Richard are sued. Rory is upset by a decision Dean has made. Dean is told to stop spending time with Rory.

gilmore-girls-s04.title: Afterboom
gilmore-girls-s04.summary: Lorelai confronts her father when she learns that he has cut business ties. Luke gives Lorelai an update on his love life.

gilmore-girls-s04.title: Luke Can See Her Face
gilmore-girls-s04.summary: A self-help tape helps a depressed Luke realize who his soul mate is. Lorelai is stressed as the Dragonfly Inn's opening day approaches.

gilmore-girls-s04.title: Last Week Fights, This Week Tights
gilmore-girls-s04.summary: Jess walks his mother down the aisle at her Renaissance-themed wedding. Luke asks his new love interest on a date. Dean confides in Rory.

gilmore-girls-s04.title: Raincoats and Recipes
gilmore-girls-s04.summary: Lorelai invites friends and family to do a test run of the Dragonfly Inn opening. Two suitors pursue Lorelai.

gilmore-girls-s05.title: Say Goodbye to Daisy Miller
gilmore-girls-s05.summary: Rory and Lorelai argue about a choice Rory made. Lorelai is happy in her new relationship. Emily and Rory plan to take a European trip.

gilmore-girls-s05.title: A Messenger, Nothing More
gilmore-girls-s05.summary: After Rory apologizes to Lorelai, she sends a letter from Europe, which has unintended consequences. Meanwhile, Luke returns home.

gilmore-girls-s05.title: Written in the Stars
gilmore-girls-s05.summary: Lorelai is a little offended that no one cares about her new relationship – until it becomes a topic of heated discussion at the town meeting.

gilmore-girls-s05.title: Tippecanoe and Taylor, Too
gilmore-girls-s05.summary: Rory and Dean meet alone to discuss where they stand with each other. Lorelai and Sookie manage Jackson's campaign for a town office.

gilmore-girls-s05.title: We Got Us a Pippi Virgin!
gilmore-girls-s05.summary: Wanting to smooth over her relationship with Dean, Lorelai suggests a night out with Luke and Rory – but the evening goes awry.

gilmore-girls-s05.title: Norman Mailer, I'm Pregnant!
gilmore-girls-s05.summary: Lorelai and Sookie are thrilled when a cultural icon starts frequenting the Dragonfly Inn dining room. Rory discovers an intriguing secret society.

gilmore-girls-s05.title: You Jump, I Jump, Jack
gilmore-girls-s05.summary: Logan takes Rory to a mysterious and elaborate event. After discovering that Lorelai has a new beau, Emily and Richard spend time with him.

gilmore-girls-s05.title: The Party's Over
gilmore-girls-s05.summary: When Emily and Richard throw a party to introduce Rory to their alumni friends, she has a realization about her boyfriend.

gilmore-girls-s05.title: Emily Says Hello
gilmore-girls-s05.summary: Rory and Lorelai plan to convince Richard and Emily to reconcile, but Emily dashes their hopes by making a bold announcement.

gilmore-girls-s05.title: But Not as Cute as Pushkin
gilmore-girls-s05.summary: Rory hosts a high school student who's considering the same university, but things don't go as planned. Lorelai and her beau have their first fight.

gilmore-girls-s05.title: Women Of Questionable Morals
gilmore-girls-s05.summary: When Christopher visits Rory at college, she rejects his attempt at reconciliation. Lorelai consoles him but doesn't tell her boyfriend where she was.

gilmore-girls-s05.title: Come Home
gilmore-girls-s05.summary: Rory offers to help Logan write an article. When Richard sees Emily talking to a man she dated, he has an explosive reaction.

gilmore-girls-s05.title: Wedding Bell Blues
gilmore-girls-s05.summary: Lorelai and Rory throw Emily a party. Richard and Emily recommit to their marriage. Rory tells Logan what she wants from him.

gilmore-girls-s05.title: Say Something
gilmore-girls-s05.summary: After the disastrous scene at her parents' recent social event, Lorelai begs her boyfriend not to give up on their relationship.

gilmore-girls-s05.title: Jews and Chinese Food
gilmore-girls-s05.summary: Lorelai is upset about the recent turn of events. Luke builds sets for the elementary school play in hopes of seeing the costume designer.

gilmore-girls-s05.title: So... Good Talk
gilmore-girls-s05.summary: Richard and Emily return from their second honeymoon. Miserable Luke burns food and handles complaining customers by throwing them out of the diner.

gilmore-girls-s05.title: Pulp Friction
gilmore-girls-s05.summary: Rory regrets agreeing with her beau to date other people. Lorelai reunites with her boyfriend but remains cold toward Emily.

gilmore-girls-s05.title: To Live and Let Diorama
gilmore-girls-s05.summary: Luke helps turn an old house into a museum. Lorelai says too much during an interview about the inn. Rory, Paris and Lane have boyfriend trouble.

gilmore-girls-s05.title: But I'm a Gilmore
gilmore-girls-s05.summary: When Rory tells her beau she can't have a casual relationship with him, he gives her an unexpected response. Sookie finds herself confined to her bed.

gilmore-girls-s05.title: How Many Kropogs to Cape Cod?
gilmore-girls-s05.summary: Rory begins her internship at one of Logan's father's newspapers. Emily and Richard fawn over Rory's boyfriend, but Lorelai is not as impressed.

gilmore-girls-s05.title: Blame Booze and Melville
gilmore-girls-s05.summary: Rory is surprised by the performance review she receives from Logan's father. Luke's plan to buy the Twickham house is threatened by a competing bid.

gilmore-girls-s05.title: A House Is Not a Home
gilmore-girls-s05.summary: Lorelai rescues Rory after a night of reckless behavior. Shocked to hear her daughter's plans for the future, she turns to Luke for help.

gilmore-girls-s06.title: New and Improved Lorelai
gilmore-girls-s06.summary: Luke responds to Lorelai. Rory faces legal consequences. Angry with Rory, Richard and Emily, Lorelai cuts off ties with them.

gilmore-girls-s06.title: Fight Face
gilmore-girls-s06.summary: Rory winds up in a fight while performing community service. Lorelai gets a dog. Luke and Lorelai decide to renovate Lorelai's house.

gilmore-girls-s06.title: The UnGraduate
gilmore-girls-s06.summary: Rory takes a job at Emily's Daughters of the American Revolution office and serves as her grandmother's spy. Lorelai won't commit to a date.

gilmore-girls-s06.title: Always a Godmother, Never a God
gilmore-girls-s06.summary: Sookie hopes to reconcile the estranged Gilmore girls by asking both Lorelai and Rory to be godparents to her kids, but things don't go as planned.

gilmore-girls-s06.title: We've Got Magic to Do
gilmore-girls-s06.summary: After two separate confrontations with the Huntzbergers at a D.A.R. party, Richard and Emily realize Lorelai was right about their treatment of Rory.

gilmore-girls-s06.title: Welcome to the Doll House
gilmore-girls-s06.summary: After asking Logan about Rory's future plans, Richard admits it was a mistake to let Rory make rash decisions and discusses the matter with Lorelai.

gilmore-girls-s06.title: Twenty-One is the Loneliest Number
gilmore-girls-s06.summary: Both Lorelai and Rory are saddened that their estrangement will keep them from spending Rory's 21st birthday the way they had always planned.

gilmore-girls-s06.title: Let Me Hear Your Balalaikas Ringing Out
gilmore-girls-s06.summary: When her former boyfriend visits and reveals an amazing success, Rory begins rethinking the choices she's made with her life.

gilmore-girls-s06.title: The Prodigal Daughter Returns
gilmore-girls-s06.summary: After months of estrangement, Lorelai and Rory make their first move toward reconciliation. Luke gets a big surprise but conceals it from Lorelai.

gilmore-girls-s06.title: He's Slippin’ ‘Em Bread... Dig?
gilmore-girls-s06.summary: Rory's long-absent father reappears in her and Lorelai's lives, casting uncertainty on what this will mean for Lorelai's current relationship.

gilmore-girls-s06.title: The Perfect Dress
gilmore-girls-s06.summary: Wanting to get to know his newly discovered relative, Luke makes a visit. Lorelai sets a date but has a feeling something's not right.

gilmore-girls-s06.title: Just Like Gwen and Gavin
gilmore-girls-s06.summary: Lorelai finds out about Luke's secret, but not from Luke. She tries to be supportive, but Luke's reaction hurts her. Logan tries to win over Rory.

gilmore-girls-s06.title: Friday Night's Alright for Fighting
gilmore-girls-s06.summary: Luke gets to know April. Rory tries to get the school newspaper published after the staff quits. All four Gilmores vent their frustrations.

gilmore-girls-s06.title: You've Been Gilmored
gilmore-girls-s06.summary: Lorelai brings Luke to dinner with her parents. When Rory becomes the new editor of the school paper, her roommate kicks her out of their apartment.

gilmore-girls-s06.title: A Vineyard Valentine
gilmore-girls-s06.summary: Rory, Lorelai and their beaus spend Valentine's Day weekend on Martha's Vineyard. During their stay, Rory's boyfriend saves the day.

gilmore-girls-s06.title: Bridesmaids Revisited
gilmore-girls-s06.summary: Rory dazzles the crowd at a journalism panel, but the next day, she's devastated to learn how her boyfriend behaved during their breakup.

gilmore-girls-s06.title: I'm OK, You're OK
gilmore-girls-s06.summary: Rory forgives her beau. Luke's girlfriend is secretly upset when he spends a few days with April. Rory does some spying on her mother's behalf.

gilmore-girls-s06.title: The Real Paul Anka
gilmore-girls-s06.summary: Unhappy because Rory hasn't really forgiven him, Logan takes off with his friends. Rory runs into Luke and April at a bookstore in Philadelphia.

gilmore-girls-s06.title: I Get A Sidekick Out of You
gilmore-girls-s06.summary: After she and her mother scramble to accommodate an unexpected visitor, Lane takes a big step in her life. Lorelai gives in to self-pity.

gilmore-girls-s06.title: Super Cool Party People
gilmore-girls-s06.summary: When Luke plans a birthday party for April at the diner, Lorelai wants to help and is hurt that Luke thinks it's too soon for her to meet April.

gilmore-girls-s06.title: Driving Miss Gilmore
gilmore-girls-s06.summary: Lorelai helps Emily while she's unable to see after minor eye surgery. Rory takes charge of Logan's recovery when he returns home.

gilmore-girls-s06.title: Partings
gilmore-girls-s06.summary: Rory throws a graduation party for Logan, but their time together is bittersweet. Lorelai delivers an ultimatum to Luke.

gilmore-girls-s07.title: The Long Morrow
gilmore-girls-s07.summary: Lorelai is mortified when she wakes up with an unexpected bedfellow. Rory is puzzled by Logan's going-away present.

gilmore-girls-s07.title: That's What You Get, Folks, For Makin' Whoopee
gilmore-girls-s07.summary: Rory is upset when she has to cancel a long-planned trip to Asia, so Lorelai turns her house into an Asian-themed wonderland.

gilmore-girls-s07.title: Lorelai's First Cotillion
gilmore-girls-s07.summary: Lorelai realizes her parents aren't as terrible as she thought. Rory's long-distance relationship proves to be a struggle.

gilmore-girls-s07.title: 'S Wonderful, 'S Marvelous
gilmore-girls-s07.summary: Lorelai is having trouble fully committing to her current relationship. A relative comes to stay with Luke.

gilmore-girls-s07.title: The Great Stink
gilmore-girls-s07.summary: Rory is thrilled when her beau comes to town on business but realizes during a dinner with his colleagues that she has no connection to his new world.

gilmore-girls-s07.title: Go, Bulldogs!
gilmore-girls-s07.summary: Christopher treats Rory's college newspaper co-workers to lunch, but the meal ends abruptly when Rory insists they cover a breaking story.

gilmore-girls-s07.title: French Twist
gilmore-girls-s07.summary: Christopher and Lorelai take Gigi to visit Sherry. Rory's tenure as editor-in-chief of the university newspaper comes to an end.

gilmore-girls-s07.title: Introducing Lorelai Planetarium
gilmore-girls-s07.summary: Rory initially pretends to be thrilled about Lorelai's announcement, but later lets her mother know how upset she is when they're alone.

gilmore-girls-s07.title: Knit, People, Knit!
gilmore-girls-s07.summary: Christopher's well-intentioned gesture at Stars Hollow's knit-a-thon brings the event to an early end.

gilmore-girls-s07.title: Merry Fisticuffs
gilmore-girls-s07.summary: When Christopher witnesses a sweet moment between a couple, he becomes concerned about his partner's commitment to him.

gilmore-girls-s07.title: Santa's Secret Stuff
gilmore-girls-s07.summary: Luke asks Lorelai to write a character reference letter for his court case. Lorelai, Christopher and Rory have a late but extravagant Christmas.

gilmore-girls-s07.title: To Whom It May Concern
gilmore-girls-s07.summary: Sookie acts strangely. Luke attends his court case hearing. Lorelai is confronted about the character reference letter she wrote for Luke.

gilmore-girls-s07.title: I'd Rather Be In Philadelphia
gilmore-girls-s07.summary: During a family emergency, Lorelai can't reach Christopher. Meanwhile, Logan and Luke drop everything to support Rory, Lorelai, Richard and Emily.

gilmore-girls-s07.title: Farewell, My Pet
gilmore-girls-s07.summary: Rory has a crush on the teacher filling in for Richard. Christopher and Lorelai talk about their current relationship with each other.

gilmore-girls-s07.title: I'm a Kayak, Hear Me Roar
gilmore-girls-s07.summary: Lorelai helps Emily organize domestic affairs but has trouble revealing the current state of her love life. Rory attends a birthday dinner for Logan.

gilmore-girls-s07.title: Will You Be My Lorelai Gilmore?
gilmore-girls-s07.summary: Rory has an interview. Lorelai must settle a fight between Lane and her mother. Logan reveals a failure to Rory.

gilmore-girls-s07.title: Gilmore Girls Only
gilmore-girls-s07.summary: Lorelai, Rory and Emily go on a road trip to attend the wedding of an old friend. Someone makes a surprise appearance, asking Rory to forgive him.

gilmore-girls-s07.title: Hay Bale Maze
gilmore-girls-s07.summary: Rory shows her boyfriend around Stars Hollow, while Lorelai worries he's too irresponsible. Lorelai and Luke admit they both made mistakes.

gilmore-girls-s07.title: It's Just Like Riding a Bike
gilmore-girls-s07.summary: After an awkward encounter, Lorelai and Luke start fighting, which Lorelai takes as a good sign. Rory gets a letter that impacts her future plans.

gilmore-girls-s07.title: Lorelai? Lorelai?
gilmore-girls-s07.summary: Rory has a scary dream about what lies ahead for her. A visitor discusses Rory's future with Lorelai. Lorelai pours her heart out on karaoke night.

gilmore-girls-s07.title: Unto The Breach
gilmore-girls-s07.summary: Emily and Richard host a graduation party for Rory. Lorelai and Christopher are relieved to find they can still be friends. Logan surprises Rory.

gilmore-girls-s07.title: Bon Voyage
gilmore-girls-s07.summary: In this series finale, Rory makes a sudden change in her summer plans, and Luke enlists everyone in Stars Hollow to throw her a farewell party.

There Is No War in Ba Sing Se

avatar-tla-s01.title: The Boy in the Iceberg
avatar-tla-s01.summary: Two teenage siblings (Sokka and Katara) living in the South Pole discover a very strange boy (Aang), along with his pet flying bison Appa, in an iceberg.

avatar-tla-s01.title: The Avatar Returns
avatar-tla-s01.summary: Katara and Sokka discover that Aang is the long-lost Avatar and must rescue him when a firebending prince named Zuko kidnaps him.

avatar-tla-s01.title: The Southern Air Temple
avatar-tla-s01.summary: Aang is excited about going home for the first time in one hundred years, but he is shocked to find out that the temple is deserted.

avatar-tla-s01.title: The Warriors of Kyoshi
avatar-tla-s01.summary: The gang arrives at Kyoshi Island and are captured by some Kyoshi warriors.

avatar-tla-s01.title: The King of Omashu
avatar-tla-s01.summary: Aang's abilities as an airbender are challenged by a strange king.

avatar-tla-s01.title: Imprisoned
avatar-tla-s01.summary: In a nearby Earth Village, the gang meets a teenage earthbender named Haru. This village lives in fear of the Fire Nation, for soldiers there capture any earthbenders they can find.

avatar-tla-s01.title: The Spirit World: Winter Solstice (1)
avatar-tla-s01.summary: Aang and friends visit a village being terrorized by an angry spirit. Iroh is captured by Earth Kingdom soldiers.

avatar-tla-s01.title: Avatar Roku: Winter Solstice (2)
avatar-tla-s01.summary: To contact the spirit of the previous Avatar, Aang must reach a temple in the Fire Nation before the sun sets on the following day. There he will learn what he must do to restore balance to the world.

avatar-tla-s01.title: The Waterbending Scroll
avatar-tla-s01.summary: After Katara attempts to teach Aang waterbending, but realizes that he is learning it much faster than she is, she is desperate to improve her abilities.

avatar-tla-s01.title: Jet
avatar-tla-s01.summary: While traveling towards the North Pole, the group almost gets captured by the Fire Nation.

avatar-tla-s01.title: The Great Divide
avatar-tla-s01.summary: While on their way to the North Pole, Aang and his friends arrive at a giant canyon where two groups of refugees are bickering over who should get to go across.

avatar-tla-s01.title: The Storm
avatar-tla-s01.summary: Sokka accepts a job for a fisherman who is looking for someone to help him out with his fishing.

avatar-tla-s01.title: The Blue Spirit
avatar-tla-s01.summary: While Aang, Katara and Sokka are traveling, Sokka gets a fever. Katara and Aang try to help Sokka, when Katara also catches the fever. It's up to Aang to go up on his own to save his two friends.

avatar-tla-s01.title: The Fortuneteller
avatar-tla-s01.summary: When the group tries to help a man who is being attacked by a platypus-bear, they discover that the local town has a fortuneteller named Aunt Wu in it, who has been forecasting the town's fate for years.

avatar-tla-s01.title: Bato of the Water Tribe
avatar-tla-s01.summary: Aang feels neglected as Katara and Sokka reunite with Bato, an old friend of their father’s from the South Pole.

avatar-tla-s01.title: The Deserter
avatar-tla-s01.summary: Aang and his friends go to a Fire Nation town so that Aang can witness some firebending, but their plan soon goes awry when it’s discovered that he is the Avatar.

avatar-tla-s01.title: The Northern Air Temple
avatar-tla-s01.summary: When Aang and his friends hear rumors about surviving airbenders, they decide to stop by the Northern Air Temple on their way to the North Pole to see for themselves.

avatar-tla-s01.title: The Waterbending Master
avatar-tla-s01.summary: When Aang tries to find the north pole, he is found by the north pole instead.

avatar-tla-s01.title: The Siege of the North (1)
avatar-tla-s01.summary: Zhao begins to launch his attack against the Northern Water Tribe. As the walls of the prestiged city begin to fall, the Avatar taps into the spirit world and seeks the help of one of the oldest spirits, in...

avatar-tla-s01.title: The Siege of the North (2)
avatar-tla-s01.summary: Aang returns from the spirit world to a big surprise. Meanwhile, Zhao and his forces continue to press deeper into the Northern Water Tribe.

avatar-tla-s02.title: The Avatar State
avatar-tla-s02.summary: Plagued with nightmares featuring the devastating power of his Avatar State, Aang and the gang meet an Earth Kingdom general who has big plans for defeating the Fire Nation.

avatar-tla-s02.title: The Cave of Two Lovers
avatar-tla-s02.summary: On their way to Omashu, Aang, Katara, and Sokka meet a group of nomads who show them a shortcut through the "Cave of Two Lovers".

avatar-tla-s02.title: Return to Omashu
avatar-tla-s02.summary: Despite the shocking news the gang have just discovered, Aang insists on trying to find Bumi within Omashu's borders, even with the dangers that will await him and his friends if his real identity is...

avatar-tla-s02.title: The Swamp
avatar-tla-s02.summary: A mysterious tornado pulls the kids into a supernatural swamp where Katara, Sokka and Aang have mysterious visions.

avatar-tla-s02.title: Avatar Day
avatar-tla-s02.summary: Aang and the gang discover an Earth town that celebrates something called "Avatar Day." But when they get there and learn the festival is of "anti-Avatar" sentiment and Aang is put on trial for a crime a past...

avatar-tla-s02.title: The Blind Bandit
avatar-tla-s02.summary: In search for an earthbending teacher for Aang, the kids go to an underground earthbending tournament called Earth Rumble 6, where they encounter Toph, a blind but powerful earthbending girl.

avatar-tla-s02.title: Zuko Alone
avatar-tla-s02.summary: Zuko travels by himself to an Earth Kingdom town where he meets a local boy. The two almost become friends, while Zuko suffers from flashbacks of his past.

avatar-tla-s02.title: The Chase
avatar-tla-s02.summary: Tired from trying to escape a machine that shows up every time they try to sleep, Aang and the gang have to escape Azula and her team, but their exhaustion leads to a tight situation.

avatar-tla-s02.title: Bitter Work
avatar-tla-s02.summary: Toph's instructing abilities come into question when Aang cannot seem to overcome a block that keeps him from earthbending.

avatar-tla-s02.title: The Library
avatar-tla-s02.summary: When Aang and his friends find a professor who knows of a library that contains information about the world, Sokka decides to go there to hopefully find some information to use against the Fire Nation.

avatar-tla-s02.title: The Desert
avatar-tla-s02.summary: Aang searches for Appa while Katara struggles to keep everyone together to survive in the vast desert. Meanwhile, Iroh and Zuko seek help from an ancient secret society.

avatar-tla-s02.title: The Serpent's Pass / The Drill
avatar-tla-s02.summary: When Aang and the gang meet up with a group of refugees, they tell the gang where they can get on a ferry to Ba Sing Se.

avatar-tla-s02.title: City of Walls and Secrets
avatar-tla-s02.summary: Having finally made it into Ba Sing Se, the kids are given a house in the upper ring. The kids are anxious to tell the Earth King their plan but there are complications.

avatar-tla-s02.title: The Tales of Ba Sing Se
avatar-tla-s02.summary: A series of short stories, highlighting different characters and their individual adventures in the city. Tales of Katara and Toph, Iroh, Sokka, Aang, Zuko, and Momo.

avatar-tla-s02.title: Appa's Lost Days
avatar-tla-s02.summary: Appa's journey from being abducted in the desert to the present is explored.

avatar-tla-s02.title: Lake Laogai
avatar-tla-s02.summary: Aang and his friends continue to search for Appa and, unbeknownst to them, they aren't the only ones looking for him.

avatar-tla-s02.title: The Earth King
avatar-tla-s02.summary: The kids battle Long Feng and the Dai Li when they attempt to show the Earth King the vast conspiracy taking place in his city. Zuko becomes seriously ill and has feverish dreams as he faces a spiritual crisis.

avatar-tla-s02.title: The Guru / The Crossroads of Destiny
avatar-tla-s02.summary: Aang travels to the Eastern Air temple to receive guidance from Guru Pathik while Sokka is reunited with his long-lost father.

avatar-tla-s03.title: The Awakening
avatar-tla-s03.summary: Aang awakens to find himself aboard a captured Fire Nation ship with a full head of hair and sustaining serious injuries from the previous battle for Ba Sing Se.

avatar-tla-s03.title: The Headband
avatar-tla-s03.summary: To better blend in as Fire Nation citizens, Aang enrolls in a Fire Nation school, giving himself an opportunity to learn more about the Nation and to enjoy life as a normal kid for the first time since he...

avatar-tla-s03.title: The Painted Lady
avatar-tla-s03.summary: When the gang arrives at a suffering fishing village, a mysterious spirit appears to help the villagers.

avatar-tla-s03.title: Sokka's Master
avatar-tla-s03.summary: Feeling as though he isn't contributing enough to the group, Sokka seeks out an elusive swordsmaster from whom he can learn the ways of the blade.

avatar-tla-s03.title: The Beach
avatar-tla-s03.summary: Zuko, Azula, Mai and Ty Lee take a vacation to Ember Island. In the process, they come to learn more about themselves and each other as well as their desires for the future.

avatar-tla-s03.title: The Avatar and the Firelord
avatar-tla-s03.summary: The tale of Avatar Roku and Fire Lord Sozin is revealed to Aang and Zuko by different sources. Both learn about themselves and are shown the origins of the war.

avatar-tla-s03.title: The Runaway
avatar-tla-s03.summary: When Katara expresses her disapproval of Toph's new way to make quick cash, the group finds her too motherly and tension grows between Katara and Toph.

avatar-tla-s03.title: The Puppetmaster
avatar-tla-s03.summary: The gang investigates the bizarre disappearances taking place within an eerie town.

avatar-tla-s03.title: Nightmares and Daydreams
avatar-tla-s03.summary: Four days prior the invasion, Aang becomes nervous over his soon-to-come confrontation with the Fire Lord.

avatar-tla-s03.title: The Day of Black Sun: The Invasion (1)
avatar-tla-s03.summary: The day of the eclipse has arrived, and the invasion force gathers together to make last preparations. They infiltrate the island and the battle begins. Meanwhile, Aang searches for the Fire Lord.

avatar-tla-s03.title: The Western Air Temple
avatar-tla-s03.summary: Aang and the group arrive at the Western Air Temple, with Zuko in pursuit. Zuko wishes to help the Avatar end the war by teaching him firebending.

avatar-tla-s03.title: The Firebending Masters
avatar-tla-s03.summary: While teaching Aang firebending, Zuko realizes that he has lost all his firebending skills.

avatar-tla-s03.title: The Boiling Rock (1) / The Boiling Rock (2)
avatar-tla-s03.summary: Sokka wants to break his father out of jail and asks Zuko for information on Fire Nation prisons.

avatar-tla-s03.title: The Southern Raiders
avatar-tla-s03.summary: Katara decides to confront the Fire Nation soldier responsible for her mother's death. Aang tries to talk her out of it, but she doesn't listen.

avatar-tla-s03.title: The Ember Island Players
avatar-tla-s03.summary: A play recounting the gang's adventures does not sit well with Aang and his friends, except for Toph who enjoys it very much. Meanwhile, Aang confesses his love to Katara, but the response is ambiguous.

avatar-tla-s03.title: Sozin's Comet (Parts 1-4)
avatar-tla-s03.summary: Aang struggles to decide whether or not he has to kill the Fire Lord and, during the night, is drawn toward an island which disappears before morning.
